title: One Time performance budgets and bundle delivery

reasons: The source names performance budgets, bundle splitting, caching, compression, and provider-session optimization.
The existing Operations split-shell contract has a failing 1.2 MB startup JS assertion.
The final deploy verifier depends on local performance proof before release.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Production Brotli/gzip and Vary: Accept-Encoding proof requires deployment/live headers and remains under REQ-20260712-112 if no live release occurs in this packet.
No DNS, provider account, payment/access, email, WhatsApp/WAPI, Telegram, GHL, LeadConnector, or production data mutation is allowed in this packet.
recommended_packet_sequence: measure current Operations shell byte sizes and local CRM/landing performance
patch split-shell generation or static delivery only as needed
run shell contract, cache policy, CRM smoke, landing smoke, and run validators
record local performance proof and remaining deploy/live header requirements
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Implement REQ-20260712-111 only; do not deploy or close REQ-20260712-112 from this packet.

operator_intent_summary: Make the One Time Operations and public surfaces measurably lighter and release-ready by meeting local performance budgets, bundle delivery constraints, static cache contracts, and exact evidence requirements before final deploy/live-smoke closeout.
raw_quotes: Meet and record Operations/CRM/public performance budgets, bundle splitting, caching, compression, and provider-session optimization.
Operations shell, CRM first page/list/detail, public landing, and large-fixture CRM query budgets are measured and met or blocked with exact evidence.
Authenticated HTML is non-cacheable while fingerprinted assets are long-cacheable.
Brotli/gzip and Vary: Accept-Encoding are verified on One Time and BNA production domains.
Vimeo loads only when a video is opened.

decisions_captured.decision: Original source screenshots are unavailable locally, so regenerated audit/smoke evidence is the baseline.

out_of_scope: No deployment, production release, live SHA verification, or live production header claim; those remain REQ-20260712-112.
No external email, WhatsApp/WAPI, Telegram, payment/access, DNS/provider-account mutation, production data mutation, GHL, LeadConnector, or external CRM write.
No raising the 1.2 MB Operations shell test threshold as a substitute for reducing startup bytes.

inspected: public/js/operations-shell.js is 1233058 bytes locally, above the 1200000 byte startup budget asserted by tests/operations-shell-navigation-contract.test.js.
public/operations-bootstrap.html remains small at 1724 bytes and loads /css/operations-shell.css plus /js/operations-shell.js.
server.js sets no-store/private cache policies for Operations shell assets and public static cache policies for public assets.
REQ-20260712-106 and REQ-20260712-107 local CRM smoke already records first-page CRM request/card/rerender metrics.
REQ-20260712-109 local landing smoke records public landing screenshots, no helper assets, and no write requests.
known_gaps: Operations split-shell startup JS exceeds the 1.2 MB local contract.
No REQ-20260712-111-specific local performance report yet consolidates shell bytes, CRM metrics, landing metrics, cache policy, and remaining live compression blockers.
Production Brotli/gzip/Vary proof cannot be claimed without deploy/live readback.

expanded_phrases.performance budgets: Local proof must include the Operations startup JS byte budget, bootstrap byte budget, CRM first-page API/card/rerender metrics, public landing smoke metrics, and any exact blocker for live-only compression/header checks.
expanded_phrases.bundle splitting: The /operations route must keep a small HTML bootstrap and split non-initial heavy renderers into a deferred chunk without breaking service-provider overview or CRM workbench behavior.
expanded_phrases.cached/compressed/fingerprinted: Local static policy tests must show authenticated/private shells are no-store or private no-cache, while public assets keep cache headers. Production gzip/Brotli/Vary and fingerprint readback remain a deploy/live verifier requirement if not locally available.
expanded_phrases.launch-ready: For this packet, launch-ready means local performance gates pass and remaining live release/header checks are explicitly carried into REQ-20260712-112.
expanded_phrases.Vimeo loads only when opened: Local/static proof must confirm the member library/classroom startup path does not eagerly load a Vimeo iframe before a video is opened, or record the exact blocker.
expanded_phrases.CRM: For this packet, CRM is a verification readback surface only: reuse existing One Time CRM smoke metrics to ensure shell delivery changes did not regress bounded first-page list/detail behavior.
expanded_phrases.clean: For this packet, clean means generated shell output removes redundant leading extraction indentation while preserving behavior; it does not mean redesigning UI or changing unrelated product flows.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Use first-party static/Playwright/Node measurements and existing BNA routes. Do not introduce GHL, LeadConnector, external provider writes, or live sends.

requirements.title: Meet One Time performance budgets and bundle delivery requirements
requirements.expected_result: Operations shell, CRM first page/list/detail, public landing, and large-fixture CRM query budgets are measured and met or blocked with exact evidence; Operations bundles are split/minified/fingerprinted/compressed/cached as required.
acceptance_criteria: CRM list API for 50 contacts is within budget or exact blocker recorded.
Initial CRM calls/rows/DOM/long-task budgets are recorded.
Authenticated HTML is non-cacheable while fingerprinted assets are long-cacheable.
Brotli/gzip and Vary: Accept-Encoding are verified on One Time and BNA production domains or carried as a REQ-20260712-112 live blocker.
Vimeo loads only when a video is opened.

criteria: REQ-20260712-105 CRM pagination/API proof is done locally.
REQ-20260712-106 CRM frontend performance proof is done locally.
REQ-20260712-109 public landing launcher proof is done locally.
The known split-shell byte-budget failure has been reproduced and scoped to generated Operations shell delivery.
No external provider mutation, live deploy, or production send is in scope.
